scope: 20 sessions: 5 articles x A-B/A-C/A-D/A-E; fresh Mistral A-E adapters

training.training_content: five exact assigned article texts only; EOS at each article end

generation.seed_policy: (base seed + first 8 hex digits of SHA256(matched call id)) modulo 2^32; same call id across model families

consensus: first determinate substantive agreement; check independent initials and after every debate turn, including incorrect agreement; no later participant call
review: source-independent whole-response semantic consensus review before next turn; accuracy evaluated separately
history: Exact full own article and complete labeled conversation in one user message, as in the latest persona diagnostic; no old REASON ledger or debate template.
prompt_amendment: Verbatim latest agreed elaborated persona/structured-reasoning draft in src/prompt.py; both agents identical template, only identifiers substituted. This exact draft was not previously tested.
execution: All training, inference, evaluation and report computations through Jupyter kernels on the existing VM; local authoring, transport, inspection and mirrored outputs.
comparison: paired descriptive configured-system pilot; architecture, tokenizer, module count and quantizer differences logged; not causal effect of model family or training
approved: User authorized full V8 on October 4, 2026 and requested exact latest prompt.py.
initial_disagreement: Required design target, checked on all 40 fresh independent initial responses; preserve and report any initial agreement or unfaithful answer, no resampling or hidden exclusions.
quality_targets: new supported reasoning where evidence permits
quality_evaluation: Separate lexical copying from logic reuse; same sound logic and stable facts may recur. No outcome/repetition-based repair generation.
